Core day-to-day activities will include aligning with engineers to test and troubleshoot complex electronics and RF circuitry from component level to system level. jobs.description_text: The Manager, Shared Services & Process Improvement designs, improves, and documents the processes that run across the People Team, so that work is done once, done the same way, and done in the right place. Working with People Operations, HRIS, Benefits, Leave, and ADA, Employee Relations, Talent, Learning and Development, and the business partners, this role maps how work flows today, recommends what to automate, support with AI, redesign, or stop, and drives approved changes through to adoption. As the first process improvement hire, this role is the prerequisite to a longer-term automation roadmap for the People Team, which maps People Team work to automation, skill-building, AI agents, and eventually fully autonomous processes. It works from a prioritized improvement backlog set with People leadership, defines the service measures that show whether changes are working, and designs the shared services model, including the rotation that gives entry-level team members a path into other People Team roles. The role also directs and develops the Shared Services team as its formal people manager, and coaches the early-career team members who rotate through it. It is expected to use Aledade's approved AI tooling to speed up process mapping, documentation, and analysis, with human review of all output. The role needs to be excited to join a fast-paced startup with significant opportunity for growth and make a positive contribution to the healthcare field.

The Manager balances people leadership with hands-on operational ownership, resolving practice needs as they arise, removing blockers for the team, and translating executive priorities into repeatable systems that scale.

This leadership role encompasses strategic oversight of the new SME function while managing day-to-day operations ensure that we achieve our profit and loss targets for the Enterprise market. jobs.description_text: At Aledade, we empower primary care physicians with technology to keep their patients healthy, preventing unnecessary hospitalizations. As the Senior Engineering Manager for our Data Modeling team, you will be a highly technical leader delivering high business impact on projects of increasing dependencies and ambiguity. You will build and empower a high-efficiency team of individual contributors, with a relentless focus on scaling data throughput while maintaining uncompromising data quality. In this role, your team will develop the foundational technology that saves lives and improves mental and physical health for millions of people. You will guide the architectural and operational modeling of complex healthcare domains aligned with FHIR concepts—including claims, encounters, attribution, medications, and clinical status—leveraging tools like DBT, Kafka, Snowflake, Databricks. Bonus Qualifications: While strong engineering leadership is paramount, hands-on expertise with Snowflake, Databricks, and deep healthcare business domain knowledge are strong pluses that will help you accelerate your team's success.

jobs.title: Senior GRC Engineer II
jobs.description_text: As a Sr Security Engineer II on the Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team, you will play a central role in strengthening and sustaining our cybersecurity posture, policy governance, and regulatory compliance programs. Operating within the Information Security GRC team, you will serve as a primary steward of Aledade’s security policies, policy governance, cyber risk management frameworks, and continuous audit readiness. In this role, you will act as the key liaison and point person for security risk intake, providing expert risk advisory, trade-off analysis, and actionable guidance to cross-functional stakeholders across Engineering, IT, Legal, Product, and Business Operations. You will directly maintain and manage Aledade’s InfoSec issue tracker and risk register, ensuring that security findings, control gaps, and risk mitigations are rigorously documented, assigned, and tracked to closure. Furthermore, you will work closely with your manager to produce and report monthly and quarterly KPIs and metrics for leadership, as well as facilitate key audit and assessment engagements—including SOC 2 Type 2 attestation, SOX ITGC testing, HIPAA/HITRUST reviews, NIST 800-53 assessments, and other internal assessments—ensuring seamless evidence collection, auditor coordination, and continuous compliance across Aledade's healthcare ecosystem.

jobs.description_text: GenBio AI is an AI for Science company on a mission to make biology fully computable. We are building AIDO (AI-Driven Digital Organism) to simulate living systems, decode biology holistically, and accelerate medical and scientific research. Our first step toward that mission is AIDO Cell, the first virtual cell world model that holistically simulates cell biology from molecules up to whole-cell behavior. It enables researchers to run experiments virtually, predicting how cells respond to genetic changes, drugs and other interventions before going into the lab. It is supported by AIDO Foundry, an AI-builds-AI engineering framework for automating virtual cell development, and AIDO Lab, an interface to digitally run experiments and observe the results. Together they form the foundation for a new paradigm in AI-driven drug discovery, bioengineering, and fundamental biomedical research.

jobs.title: Technical Buyer
jobs.description_text: The Vehicle team builds the aircraft at the heart of Rainmaker’s cloud seeding operations. We design, build, and fly autonomous drones that go where other systems won’t. Our aircraft fly into icing, turbulence, high winds, and low visibility, because that’s where the clouds worth seeding are. We own the full flight system end to end: UAS: airframe, propulsion, avionics, and the autonomy that keeps our aircraft flying safely and reliably in severe weather. Dispersion payload: the hardware that delivers seeding material precisely, at the right place and time inside a cloud. Sensing systems: onboard instruments that measure the atmosphere around the aircraft, so we can see conditions as they happen and show what each mission accomplished. We’re a small, hands-on team that takes hardware from first sketch to field deployment. Engineers here design a part, test it on the bench, and watch it fly in conditions most drone programs would ground for. If you like hard problems where the environment fights back, and you want your work to put water on the ground, you’ll fit in here.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Robotics Hardware
jobs.description_text: Job Description: Machina Labs is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to own mechanical hardware design for our robotic sheet forming cells, taking designs from concept through release and into production. You will own the design of machine subsystems, make and defend the design decisions that set how that hardware performs, lasts, and is serviced, and work closely with Robotics, Forming Process, Electrical, Controls, and Production to get it built and running reliably. As the machine and the company grow, the areas you own will grow and shift with them. The ideal candidate has owned a complex mechanical subsystem on industrial machinery, robotics, CNC, or automation equipment, and is comfortable taking it from first concept to hardware running in production.

jobs.title: FP&A Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About the Role As our FP&A Intern, you’ll work on the numbers leadership uses to run the company. You’ll help build the annual plan, quarterly forecasts, and long-range models, and you’ll present your work to our senior leadership team. You’ll report to the FP&A Manager and work on the real plan, the real forecasts, and the materials that go in front of our board. Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace, which makes the finance work here unusually interesting. You’ll dig into how supply and demand grow market by market, what drives our take rate, and what it costs to acquire a host or a renter. By the end of the summer, you’ll own expense forecasting for the entire business. This internship is a direct path to a full-time role. Strong performers leave with a full-time offer to join the team after graduation.

jobs.title: Marketplace Growth Associate
jobs.description_text: About the Role As a Marketplace Growth Associate, you’ll work with Neighbor’s hosts: the commercial and residential property owners who list their storage and parking space on our marketplace. Hosts are the supply side of everything we do. The more easily renters can find a host’s space, the more that host earns and the faster the marketplace grows in every city we serve. You’ll be one of the people making that happen, one host at a time. Most of your day (50–75%) is outbound phone calls with hosts. On each call, you’ll help a host make their listing stronger and easier to find: setting up a Google Maps pin, tightening photos and descriptions, getting the price right, and building up reviews. The goal is to turn their space into steady, growing income. The rest of your time is operations: running the signage program, tracking results and finding ways to make the whole thing work better. This role fits you if you like being on the phone, you can manage a high volume of work on your own, and you tend to notice when a process could run better.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description_text: At Neighbor, we’re building the largest hyperlocal marketplace the world has ever seen. We’ve raised over $75 million from top-tier investors such as Andreessen Horowitz and the CEOs of DoorDash, StockX, and Uber. Our marketplace is already flourishing in all 50 states and we’re just getting started! As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for setting the vision, defining the strategy, and driving the execution of a meaningful part of our marketplace. You will pioneer a standard of customer obsession, analytical rigor, and AI-augmented velocity that makes Neighbor fundamentally better for our hosts and renters across all 50 states.

jobs.title: UX Designer (Junior, Mid and Senior Level Opportunities Available)
jobs.description_text: About the Role Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace for self storage and vehicle storage. Hosts list everything from garages and driveways to RV pads and commercial facility units, and renters compare options, book, and manage reservations through Neighbor’s website and apps. You’ll report directly to a Co-Founder and our VP of Product & Design, and you’ll set the bar for design craft across the company. That means mentoring Neighbor’s other designers, shaping product direction with PMs and engineers from the first sketch, and making sure real renter insight reaches every team. Renters on Neighbor compare everything from storage facility units to neighborhood garages and RV pads. Helping them choose with confidence is a hard design problem, and solving it moves the business directly. This role is based in our Lehi, Utah office, in person Tuesday through Friday, with the option to work from home on Mondays.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description_text: OpenX is seeking an Account Manager to partner with our CTV publisher clients to drive revenue growth across our programmatic marketplace. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of mid-market CTV publishers with the goal to deepen strategic relationships, and guide partners in leveraging OpenX’s technology, including Audience, Data and PMP solutions. We’re looking for a strategic, analytical, and consultative team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment and understands how to build strong client relationships. You will work closely with Publisher Business Development, Solutions Architects, Buyer Development, and Product to deliver results and ensure publishers experience the full value of partnering with OpenX.

jobs.title: People Coordinator
jobs.description_text: Company at a Glance OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens. At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising. The People (HR) Coordinator supports day-to-day human resources operations while leading special projects that strengthen recordkeeping, systems, and processes. This position partners with People Team leadership to improve operational efficiency, maintain accurate and compliant employee records, analyze HR data, and provide actionable insights that support organizational decision-making.

jobs.title: Sr Director, DSP Partnerships & Growth
jobs.description_text: OpenX is seeking a strategic, commercially driven Senior Director, DSP Partnerships & Growth (Americas) to lead the regional DSP partnerships organization and accelerate revenue growth across established and emerging buying platforms. As the programmatic ecosystem evolves, OpenX is redefining how supply-side and demand-side platforms collaborate to drive performance, efficiency, and innovation. This leader will play a critical role in strengthening our position with leading DSPs, expanding demand diversification, and translating emerging market opportunities into sustainable commercial growth. This is more than a traditional partnership management role. We're looking for a commercial builder and strategic operator who can independently lead a high-performing team, establish executive-level relationships, identify new growth opportunities, and turn complex technical capabilities into differentiated business value. Reporting to the Global Head of DSP, this leader will drive the commercial growth and execution of OpenX's US DSP partnerships, translating strategic priorities into measurable revenue outcomes while collaborating closely with DSP Operations, Product, and cross-functional commercial teams.

jobs.title: SVP, Global Buyer Development
jobs.description_text: OpenX is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Vice President of Global Buyer Development to lead our agency and brand facing Sales and Account Management teams. This executive will be responsible for driving global buyer strategy, growing revenue, and owning customer relationships across agency holding companies, independent agencies, and direct brands. This person will be a member of the OpenX Leadership Team. As a senior leader within the organization, the Senior Vice President will play a critical role in shaping the future of OpenX’s buyer development business. The ideal candidate will possess deep preexisting buyer relationships, understanding of programmatic advertising, a strategic mindset for business development and customer service, and a proven ability to build and lead high performing teams. This person will maintain executive relationships with leading agencies and brands, serve as a market representative of OpenX, and identify opportunities that shape our value proposition and market position. The Senior Vice President will collaborate closely with leadership across Publisher Development, DSP Partnerships, Partnerships, Product, Marketing, Commercial Operations, Finance, Legal, and HR. This person will report directly to the EVP, Commercial.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Credit Risk Analytics (Sr. level open)
jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission Prosper is seeking a Data Scientist for the Data Science team under our Credit Risk Analytics vertical. You will become a core contributor with machine learning expertise on the credit risk team and deliver results that directly impact our business. Compensation details: The salary for Data Scientist level is $129,000 - $179,000 annually, plus bonus and generous benefits. The salary for Sr. Data Scientist level is $157,000 - $205,000 annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Loan Operations
jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission Ready to make an impact? We’re looking for a highly capable Senior Manager of Loan Operations to join our team. Your primary objective will be to optimize and modernize our loan verification process, moving from manual, touch-heavy procedures to a streamlined, automated operational workflow. In this role, you will lead, mentor, and motivate our Loan Operations teams in Phoenix and San Francisco, while also overseeing our vendor partnerships. You will champion a strategic approach to scaling our business—focusing on scaling through workflow efficiencies and process improvements rather than linear staffing growth. Reporting to the Director of Operations, you will manage operational processes, oversee key vendor relationships, and identify opportunities to integrate modern solutions to improve department-wide productivity & quality. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $87,000 - $105,000 annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: Sr. Application Security Engineer
jobs.description_text: Your role in our mission We are seeking a Sr. Application Security Engineer to join our security team. In this role, you will be a critical partner to engineering, product, and SRE teams, helping to identify, assess, and mitigate security risks across the software development lifecycle (SDLC). You will drive security by design, shape our product security standards, and ensure vulnerabilities are identified, tracked, and resolved efficiently. This is a hands-on technical role. You’ll lead secure architecture and design reviews, code reviews, and penetration testing, and you’ll be a core part of how Prosper builds and uses AI securely. That covers threat modeling agentic systems, red teaming AI applications, building AI defenses, and assessing AI risk across internal tools and vendors. The expected working hours for this role are based in Pacific Time. Compensation details: The salary for this position is $190k - $220k annually, plus bonus and generous benefits.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Wiring Harness and Electrical Platform
jobs.description_text: PlusAI is a Physical AI company pioneering AI-based virtual driver software for factory-built autonomous trucks. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in the United States and Europe, Plus was named by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next-generation autonomous trucks. If you’re ready to make a huge impact and drive the future of autonomy, Plus is looking for talented individuals to join its fast-growing teams.

jobs.title: Fleet Manager
jobs.description_text: About this role: As Fleet Manager, you will own the maintenance, compliance, and lifecycle of PlusAI's mixed fleet, spanning distinct vehicle types including autonomous Class 8 semi-trucks, passenger cars, and trailers. You will build and run a preventative maintenance program that maximizes uptime, keep the fleet audit-ready under DOT, FMCSA, California regulatory requirements, and manage every asset from acquisition and leasing through registration, insurance, and disposal. Working closely with AV hardware and software teams, vehicle operations, and external repair shops and mobile mechanics, you will adapt traditional fleet practices to the demands of autonomous trucking. This role requires meticulous attention to detail, strong vendor and cross-functional leadership, and a safety- and compliance-first mindset.

jobs.title: Aircraft Mechanic II
jobs.description_text: Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market. Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026. Mobility is one of the most highly-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us.

This engineer will translate system risks and requirements into safe, instrumented, repeatable tests at the cell and pack levels, then convert test results into defensible engineering evidence and actionable design improvements.

jobs.title: Internship, Supply Chain Analyst (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: Summary: The Supply Chain Analyst Intern will support the Manufacturing & Supply Chain organization in executing day-to-day procurement, planning, and supplier coordination activities. This role provides hands-on exposure to a fast-paced aerospace production environment, with responsibilities spanning supplier execution, ERP data management, and process improvement. The intern will work cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Receiving, and Accounting to ensure material availability, supplier responsiveness, and data accuracy during production ramp.

jobs.title: Lead Planner - MRO
jobs.description_text: We are seeking an experienced, proactive Lead Planner, MRO to own maintenance planning, scheduling, and material coordination for Pivotal's BlackFly and Helix eVTOL fleet. This role turns maintenance requirements, customer service requests, and engineering dispositions into execution-ready work packages, and maintains the schedule, status, and availability of every aircraft in the MRO-owned fleet. As a key cross-functional integrator, the Lead Planner, MRO partners with MRO technicians, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Flight Operations, Customer Support, and Marketing to balance customer service, fleet availability, and material readiness, while driving down aircraft downtime and giving leadership a clear, data-driven view of fleet readiness.

jobs.title: Manager, Configuration Management
jobs.description_text: About the Role The Manager, Configuration Management builds and leads Pivotal’s configuration management (CM) function. This role owns the company’s configuration management plan, serves as a key stakeholder on the Change Control Board (CCB), and is accountable for accurate, traceable product configuration for all Pivotal aircraft, hardware, and software, from initial design release through production, delivery, and in-service support. This individual will lead a team of configuration specialists and engineers, set CM policy and governance in 3DEXPERIENCE (PLM) and Epicor (ERP), and partner with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and customer support leaders to scale change control as Pivotal grows production and works toward certification. The role is critical to product integrity, certification traceability, and audit readiness.

jobs.title: Senior Battery Engineering Technician
jobs.description_text: About the Role We are looking for a highly motivated and hands-on Battery Engineering Technician to join our battery team in a fast-paced eVTOL startup environment. You will work closely with battery engineers to build, test, and characterize battery modules and packs — from prototype builds through validation. This role requires strong attention to detail, a safety-first mindset, and the ability to adapt quickly to shifting priorities.

jobs.title: Senior Flight Test Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Flight Test Engineer at Pivotal, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing flight test activities to validate the performance, handling qualities, and safety of our UAS and crewed eVTOL aircraft. This includes developing detailed test plans and procedures, supporting ground and flight tests, and analyzing results to ensure accurate data capture and reporting. You work cross-functionally with engineering, flight operations, and certification teams to ensure all testing aligns with program milestones and regulatory requirements. A strong focus on safety, technical excellence, and continuous improvement is essential in this role as we progress toward certification and commercial operation.

jobs.title: Senior GNC Engineer - Flight Controls
jobs.description_text: About the Role The GNC team at Pivotal develops the flight control and navigation algorithms that let our aircraft fly safely and precisely, including on the Helix family of aircraft. We are looking for a Senior GNC Engineer to design, tune, and verify flight control laws for our aircraft, taking them from analysis and simulation through flight test. You will own the control laws for specific flight modes and control loops within the architecture set by the team’s technical leads. That includes analysis and tuning with CONDUIT, system identification to support our models, Monte Carlo and mission-level verification, and flight test support. You will work closely with the navigation, firmware, aeromechanical, systems engineering, and flight test teams, and help mentor less experienced engineers. The ideal candidate is a fully qualified flight controls engineer who works independently, has designed and tuned control laws that were evaluated in flight test or piloted simulation, ideally on VTOL, rotorcraft, or eVTOL aircraft, and brings sound judgment to interpreting analysis and test results.

You will be accountable for the technical approach of the flight control system across the Helix family and future aircraft, from control law architecture, redundancy, and failure accommodation to the simulation, tools, and verification processes the team uses. You will lead the flight controls team, overseeing its work and mentoring Staff and Senior engineers, shape aircraft-level decisions with program leadership, and represent flight controls to the systems engineering, safety, certification, and flight test teams, as well as to customers and partners. jobs.description_text: The Role Palantir is looking for a Talent Programs & Events Strategist to shape how we engage prospective talent through distinctive, well-designed events, programs and initiatives. You’ll develop an overarching strategy across all product teams, connecting industry events and early talent programming to Palantir’s broader goals. jobs.title: Assistant Superintendent
jobs.description_text: As our Assistant Superintendent, you will support the successful execution of commercial construction projects by assisting with daily field operations, jobsite coordination, and quality and safety oversight. In this role, you will work closely with the Superintendent and project leadership to help ensure projects are built safely, efficiently, and in accordance with plans, specifications, schedules, and company standards. Day‑to‑day, you will help coordinate subcontractor activities, monitor work‑in‑place, support short‑term planning and scheduling, and assist with site logistics, inspections, and material deliveries. You will be actively involved in enforcing safety requirements, tracking daily progress, reviewing drawings, and helping maintain an organized, productive jobsite. Experienced team members may assume increased responsibility for managing specific scopes of work, leading subcontractor coordination and sequencing, supporting site planning and logistics, assisting with inspections and punch‑list completion, and contributing to improvements in field processes and jobsite execution. Successful team members in this role are hands-on, safety-focused, organized, and proactive communicators who support efficient, high-quality, and well-coordinated project execution.

jobs.description_text: As our Carpenter Helper, you will support skilled carpenters and project teams by preparing materials, operating hand and power tools, assisting with layout and measurements, and helping maintain a safe and productive jobsite. You will perform a variety of construction support tasks, including material preparation, tool operation, layout assistance, material handling, and housekeeping activities. You will also help ensure that work areas remain clean, organized, and hazard-free while supporting project quality standards and safe work practices. As you gain experience, you will have opportunities to take on additional responsibilities, expand your trade knowledge, and further develop your carpentry skills through hands-on learning and mentorship. Successful Carpenter Helpers are committed to safety, housekeeping, teamwork, quality workmanship, and delivering excellent results in a fast-paced construction environment.

jobs.description_text: As our MEP Coordinator, you will lead the delivery of high‑quality commercial construction projects by supporting the planning, coordination, and commissioning of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and low‑voltage systems. In this role, you will ensure that building systems operate as intended by managing compliance requirements, supporting building automation integration, and overseeing testing, startup, and closeout activities across fast‑paced project environments. You will collaborate closely with project managers, superintendents, subcontractors, and design teams to ensure that all MEP work aligns with project drawings, specifications, commissioning plans, and owner requirements. You will also support the documentation, verification, and turnover processes necessary for high‑functioning and fully compliant building systems. Experienced coordinators may take on more complex systems integration responsibilities, lead commissioning meetings, work directly with owners and facility teams, assist in resolving field‑driven MEP challenges, and support continuous improvement in project execution. Successful team members in this role are committed to accuracy, system performance, safety, problem‑solving, and delivering excellent results throughout construction and commissioning.

As an Account Executive on our Enterprise team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on organizations with 1,000+ employees, where engineering environments are complex, buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and large deals can take many months to close. Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

You’ll also help shape what comes next: rolling out claiming processes in new territories as Spotify expands, finding new ways to show the accounting impact of business decisions, steering updates to our claiming systems, and streamlining month-end close in a fast-growing region.

As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world. The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. jobs.title: Grievance and Appeals Specialist
jobs.description_text: As the Grievance and Appeals Specialist, you will be responsible for independently resolving member and provider grievances and appeals within applicable state Medicaid, federal, contractual, and accreditation timeframes. You will work directly with members, providers, and authorized representatives and collaborate with Utilization Management, Claims, Member Services, Provider Relations, Pharmacy, Quality, and Compliance to achieve fair, accurate, and well-documented outcomes. You will manage moderately complex cases, support process improvement, and develop procedures and training materials. The Illinois Tailored Care Management Program helps individuals with complex health and social needs transition from nursing facilities and Specialized Mental Health Rehabilitation Facilities (SMHRFs) to community-based living. Through person-centered care management and coordinated support services, the program empowers members to live more independently and thrive in their communities.

jobs.title: RN Manager of Utilization Management
jobs.description_text: As the RNManager of Utilization Management, you will lead healthcare program operations and a team of clinical professionals supporting population health, utilization management, quality improvement, and care management activities. You will oversee contract performance, staff development, operational excellence, and client relationships while ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and accreditation requirements. You will use your knowledge of medical policy, medical coding, ICD-10 and CMS requirements to support evidence-based coverage determinations and effective utilization management practices. This role is ideal for an experienced nurse leader who enjoys building high-performing teams, improving healthcare outcomes, and partnering with clients to achieve program goals. This role offers a flexible hybrid schedule, combining the convenience of remote work with two days per week onsite for meaningful collaboration, team connection, and partnership.

jobs.title: RN Supervisor of Health Management
jobs.description_text: This position is responsible for supervising program staff and will provide technical guidance and training to staff related to the contract/program operations. Health management services may include: population health management, practice facilitation, medical/utilization management, quality improvement activities. The position will be responsible for monitoring compliance in accordance with client and contract deliverables as well as service/accreditation requirements as applicable. This role offers a flexible hybrid schedule, combining the convenience of remote work with two days per week onsite for meaningful collaboration, team connection, and partnership.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Accountant
jobs.description_text: Under minimal supervision, the Senior Financial Accountant utilizes a broad understanding of department's operations and objectives to prepare billings, revenue calculations, process monthly financial close and reporting, manage A/R aging and collections, process general ledger entries, and reconcile bank statement and other balance sheet accounts. Provides customer service to assigned business unit(s). Demonstrates proficiency with intermediate accounting functions and a working knowledge of advanced accounting functions. Ability to learn and apply regulations set forth in 48 CFR Part 31 and other applicable Federal government regulations.

jobs.title: EHS Specialist
jobs.description_text: Synthego is seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) Specialist to support environmental compliance, hazardous waste management, and workplace safety across its laboratory and manufacturing facilities in Redwood City, California. This role will be responsible for executing and maintaining EHS programs, with a strong emphasis on chemical and hazardous waste compliance, regulatory inspections, environmental reporting, and facility safety. The EHS Specialist will ensure that required inspections, assessments, permits, records, and corrective actions are completed accurately and on time. The ideal candidate has practical experience managing EHS compliance in a chemical, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or laboratory environment; a strong working knowledge of California and local environmental regulations; and the ability to work independently in a changing regulatory environment. This individual must be comfortable working directly with employees, facility and manufacturing teams, external consultants, and regulatory agencies to resolve compliance issues and implement sustainable corrective actions. This is an execution-oriented role requiring a proactive, organized professional who can identify risks, take ownership of issues through closure, and maintain a consistent state of inspection readiness.

jobs.title: Facilities Engineer
jobs.description_text: Synthego is seeking an experienced and technically driven Facilities Engineer to support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of critical facility infrastructure within a GMP-regulated biotech manufacturing and laboratory environment. This role is responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance of facility systems, with particular emphasis on GMP HVAC systems, environmental controls, hazardous materials infrastructure, and critical utilities. The Facilities Engineer will serve as a technical subject matter expert in complex system troubleshooting, root cause investigations, nonconformance management, and engineering problem-solving. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong technical ownership, an understanding of quality management systems, and the ability to develop and implement sustainable corrective actions. This position requires close collaboration with Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, Environmental Health & Safety (EHS), Service Engineering, and external service providers to ensure that facility infrastructure supports safe, compliant, and uninterrupted operations.

jobs.title: Laboratory Associate II, Pre-Clinical (Night Shift)
jobs.description_text: We are searching for motivated, detail-oriented, and hands-on individuals interested in advancing science through the manufacturing of CRISPR products. As a Laboratory Associate II at Synthego, you will join our operations team and independently execute established laboratory and production workflows. This role requires strong attention to detail, sound judgment, adaptability, and working knowledge of laboratory, safety, quality, and production protocols. The Laboratory Associate II is expected to manage routine work with limited guidance, recognize when issues require escalation, maintain accurate production documentation, collaborate cross-functionally, and support the development of other team members through training on assigned processes. 15% shift differential will be added for night shift hours.

jobs.title: Senior Contracts Attorney
jobs.description_text: The Senior Contracts Attorney provides commercial legal support across all contract and transactional aspects of the business, working closely with business teams to contribute to the company's financial and operational success. Reporting directly to the Chief Legal Officer, this role operates with significant autonomy and manages the company's contract database. Preferred locations: SF Bay Area or ATL

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Andean Region
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We’re looking for a dynamic and disciplined Senior Account Executive that can provide leadership, direction, and support to Telesat Lightspeed business in Latin America & Caribbean. The Senior Account Executive will develop and execute Business Development and Sales Strategies for Telesat Lightspeed LEO Services and Solutions in the Andean countries, with special focus on Telcos, MNOs, Service Providers and Government Users. This position reports to the Regional Sales Vice President, Latin America & Caribbean, and is responsible for aligning Telesat Lightspeed business development objectives with the company’s business strategy and business plan in the region. This remote position supports our Andean region and is open to candidates based in Bogota, Colombia or Miami, Florida.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) who will shape the future of cybersecurity across a dynamic, mission-driven organization. This is an opportunity for an entrepreneurial, forward-thinking security executive to build and lead a modern, enterprise-wide security strategy that protects our people, platforms, data, and partners while accelerating innovation. The ideal leader sees cybersecurity as more than risk management — it is a strategic capability that builds trust, enables growth, and creates competitive advantage. You will challenge conventional approaches, anticipate emerging threats, and leverage technologies such as artificial intelligence to build scalable, intelligent security capabilities. This role calls for a bold thinker and hands-on strategist who thrives in complexity, can influence the executive level, and knows how to translate security investments into meaningful business value. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $240,000 - 275,000 per year.

jobs.title: Events Security Manager
jobs.description_text: At Stand Together, events are an opportunity to deepen relationships with donors and partners, bring people together around shared goals, and advance our vision. As our events grow in scale, complexity, and visibility, we are investing in a dedicated event security capability that protects people while preserving an exceptional guest experience. We are seeking an Event Security Manager who will lead security planning and execution for our most important events while building a scalable, repeatable approach for the future. This is a unique opportunity for a hands-on, entrepreneurial security professional who can navigate complex environments, build trusted relationships, and apply sound judgment to balance security needs with the overall event experience. Success in this role means making security seamless, enabling our teams to focus on what they do best, and ensuring our events create lasting value for the people and partners we serve. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $130,000–$140,000 per year.

jobs.title: Federal Affairs Coordinator and Legislative Aide
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. As the Federal Affairs Coordinator and Legislative Aide, you will keep our Federal Government Affairs team running at its best while supporting our federal lobbyists with legislative research and bill tracking. Reporting to the Director of Federal Government Affairs, you will manage the operations, budget, and communications that free our team to focus on winning public policy change that expands freedom and opportunity. This is a high-visibility, high-trust role for a skilled administrator with Capitol Hill or advocacy experience, sound judgment, and a bias for action. You will support three national brands (Americans for Prosperity, Concerned Veterans for America, and The LIBRE Initiative) and work regularly with congressional offices, coalition partners, and senior leadership.

jobs.title: Federal Lobbyist
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. As a Federal Lobbyist (internal title: Federal Legislative Liaison), you will advocate for AFP’s positions in Washington, D.C., working under the direction of the Director of Federal Affairs. Your goal: break down the barriers that stand in the way of people realizing their full potential. You will focus on federal legislative advocacy in three key policy areas: economics, energy, and AIand emerging technology. This role is ideal for a motivated government affairs professional with a few years of Capitol Hill, state legislative, or advocacy experience who is ready to take on greater lobbying responsibility. You will build relationships with congressional offices, coalition partners, trade associations, and think tanks, and grow into a trusted voice for AFP on the Hill. You should share our commitment to advancing every individual’s right to economic opportunity through free markets.

jobs.title: Grants Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Grants Manager on the Stand Together Trust team you will lead process improvements, build capabilities, and drive operational excellence on a portfolio of grants supporting social change entrepreneurs. In this role, you will build relationships and collaborate with diverse internal stakeholders within a growing team. You will apply a detail-oriented project management background to identify gaps and drive solutions that result in transformational change. Within this new role on the Stand Together Trust team, you will support a portfolio of current and future partnerships focused on shifting education from a one-size-fits-all system to learning that’s tailored to each student’s unique gifts, interests, and needs. This role is part of the operational engine that supports Stand Together’s Education Paradigm and Programming. This role is essential to our success in keeping pace with the demand for our support and will help build a team focused on operational and relationship excellence. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $80,000–$100,000 per year.

jobs.description_text: The Koch Associate Program (KAP) is a career accelerator for early to mid-career professionals with a drive to tackle our country’s most pressing challenges in more effective, principled ways. KAP equips associates with the tools, mindsets, and community to succeed as social entrepreneurs—individuals excited to find new and better ways to break barriers and eliminate injustice. Associates spend one day each week engaging in experiential learning with Stand Together Fellowships and work at one of our many partner organizations the rest of the week. Automation & Controls Engineer, Launch Hardware Production (Starship) This role owns the controls that build Starship. You will design, commission, and operate the automation behind production systems. A 24-lane, 750,000 sq ft Starship Refurbishment facility (Gigabay) built to assemble & refurbish Starship at rate. Industrial air separation units upstream of the propellant farms. Heat shield tile manufacturing. This team owns that controls scope end to end. The work runs from a blank cabinet and a P&ID to a plant that stays up. You will specify instrumentation, program PLCs, pull in the data, commission the equipment, and then live with it in production. When a lane stops, a cold box trips, or a furnace drifts, you find it, fix it, and change the system so it does not happen again. This position is based in Cape Canaveral, FL (Kennedy Space Center). RESPONSIBILITIES Design, build, and commission the controls for a 24-lane Gigabay: production tooling, lifts, fixtures, factory services, and the data layer the floor uses. Bring industrial air separation units online and keep them running. jobs.description_text: AUTOMATION & CONTROLS ENGINEER, PCB (STARLINK/STARMIND) At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We’ve only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink’s potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers to help maximize Starlink’s utility for communities and businesses around the globe. The PCB team is revolutionizing power generation for space applications through advanced printed circuit board (PCB) manufacturing. We're scaling production of PCB's to form the backbone for millions of next generation consumer facing devices that we ship directly to customers and businesses all over the world. From private homes, RVs, planes, or boats, this team plays an instrumental role in leveling the playing field for high-speed connectivity As a PCB Automation and Controls Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize controls and automation systems for the production of PCB manufacturing equipment and material movement mechanisms. jobs.title: Automation & Controls Engineer (Starlink Optical Products)
jobs.description_text: AUTOMATION & CONTROLS ENGINEER (STARLINK OPTICAL PAYLOADS) Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers, and the software that brings it all together. As a member of the Starlink Optical Payloads Integration & Test team, you will work with elite engineers on high-impact applications to automate production lines for optical payloads, including inter-satellite lasers, optical transceivers, and star trackers . You will help create the factory of the future for high-volume optical payload production that will maximize Starlink’s impact around the globe and beyond. RESPONSIBILITIES: Design, build, qualify and implement projects spanning machine design, robotics and manufacturing processes from initial ideation to production use Architect, write, and debug PLC code Implement vision systems for robotic guidance, quality control and data collection Design systems to control processes, track factory performance and collaborate across teams to increase manufacturing efficiency in a data driven way Design user interfaces that make complex machines easy to use and troubleshoot Create electrical, pneumatic and fluid schematics for control panels Keep our factories safe by implementing ANSI/RIA15.06/OSHA compliant systems BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering
